name: Basic Storage Block Example
description:
Adds Basic Storage, a persistent nine-slot storage block assembled from private data and layout modules. Copy the complete 03_adv_03_basic_storage folder into lua_scripts. In a crafting table, surround one chest with eight wooden plank blocks to craft it.

Place the block and right-click to open its 3x3 storage grid. Move items into and out of the grid and watch 'Occupied slots' change from zero through nine. A stack of many items counts as one occupied slot; splitting that stack across several slots increases the count.

Close and reopen the screen, then save and rejoin the world with the block still placed to check that its stored items persist. Compare the inventory-change callback in main.lua with data.lua and layout.lua. Restart Minecraft after changes to this structural block, inventory, or GUI.
